note: A disputer who challenges a UMA proposal posts a bond B. On UMA's Optimistic Oracle a winning party recovers its own bond plus half the loser's bond, so the disputer's reward on a correct challenge is R*B with R = 0.5; a wrong challenge forfeits the full bond (-B). Writing friction f as the fraction of bond lost to ~49h of capital lock plus DVM-vote risk, the expected value of disputing a proposal believed wrong with probability p is EV = B*[p*(R+1) - (1+f)], which is zero at the break-even belief p* = (1+f)/(R+1). With R=0.5, f=0, p* = 0.667: a watcher must be more than two-thirds sure a specific proposal is wrong before disputing pays. Per-category accuracies are UMA's Optimistic Truth Bot (sports/asset pricing 99.3%, clear Yes/No 95%, all markets 78%, mention markets 72%); error = 1 - accuracy. Bond $750, 2h liveness, ~48h DVM vote, 1.0% of 18,427 Polygon markets disputed (+49h median) are UMA/Polymarket figures.
